note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Paavo Lipponen's broad 'rainbow' coalition of Social Democrats, National Coalition, Left Alliance, Greens and Swedish People's Party), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: strong trade unions and employers' organisations in centralised incomes-policy bargaining, organised agricultural producers close to the opposition Centre Party, a free and influential press, and a large conscript-based military under civilian control.
